description: Ministry of Parliamentary & Mass Media - Regulations promulgated under the Right to Information Act. No. 12.07.2016 come into force upon publication in the Government Gazette of Sri Lanka  & Right to Information Rules of 2017 come into  force on 03.02.2017
categorisation: This gazette content promulgates regulations under the Right to Information Act, No. 12 of 2016. It establishes legal procedures and regulatory frameworks for information requests, appeals, and compliance requirements. While it mentions a minister's name (Gayantha Karunathilake), this is only in the context of who promulgated the regulations, not detailing his portfolio responsibilities. The core content is entirely focused on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
